country to focus on the development of tactical nuclear weapons for use on the battlefield.
NPR's Anthony Kuhn reports from Seoul on Kim's remarks while touring three separate nuclear

centrifuges for making nuclear fuel on Wednesday. Kim urged his country to focus on using tactical
nuclear weapons for different missions and environments. The north has developed or is
developing means to deliver low yield nuclear warheads from the land air and sea. Kim said that
any attempt to deny or negate the north status as a nuclear power will be seen as an open declaration
of war. He added that he does not seek international approval or recognition for North Korea's nuclear
status, suggesting that he just wants foreign governments to accept it as an established fact.
Anthony Kuhn, NPR News, Seoul. And you're listening to NPR News.
